params.body: The anchorer gains 'anchor topic create --hedera operator.json', a public topic with nobody's submit key, done once per network. Run tonight against the operator's mainnet account: topic 0.0.10856156. All twelve versions of the identity log were pinned there and read back, the box switched to the mainnet operator file at 19:41 UTC, the chain heads anchored there, verify holds. The testnet topic 0.0.10275637 holds 7 to 12 September and stays readable. The two tier 3 claims lose their one caveat in the statement and the register; verify-yourself and the worked example name both topics.
